title: ChapterFile
description: A story chapter: where it starts and how its rooms connect (build plan P0). Rooms stay reusable modules; this file is the only place that says which door leads where. Cross-file checks (rooms and doors exist, sockets face each other, every room is reachable) are in tools/check-maps.ts.

id.description: Same as the folder under public/assets/maps that holds the chapter's rooms.

start.description: Room a new game opens in, as folder/map without the .tmj extension.

next.description: The chapter that follows once this one ends, after its closing cards. Absent: the game returns to the title.

intro.description: A conversation that opens as a new game of this chapter starts (the prologue's interview). Not replayed on continue.

tools.description: Tools the operator has from the start of this chapter. Absent means every tool; the prologue lists none, since the chairman hands over the stamp at its end (design doc 5.4). Tools granted earlier in the run are kept.

glucose.description: Shows the blood glucose meter and runs its rules in this chapter (design doc 7.3).

carry.description: Number or boolean tags that cross the day boundary into the next chapter. Without this only the closing cards decide what the next chapter starts with, so nothing the operator did in the rooms would reach it.

archive.description: Sleep files the day's memories (design doc 7.4, 7.6). A memory Pickup adds one to the tag `held`, up to `hands` at a time; a conversation moves what is held onto the staging desk with `move:<held>><desk>*100` (a file is 100 on the desk), where the desk's own `fadePerHour` wears it away while the operator is awake. Going to bed sets `into` to the share of `total` files still on the desk, in percent, times the night crew's caffeine coefficient at that moment and the `climax` archive factor when its flag is on. Put `into` in `carry` for the next chapter to read it.

held.description: Number tag counting the memory files in the operator's hands.

hands.description: How many files the operator can hold at once; a pickup beyond it stays on the floor.

desk.description: Number tag for the staging desk, 100 for each file on it.

total.description: How many memory files the chapter's rooms hold.

into.description: Number tag set on going to bed, in percent.

closedCases.description: Enemy types whose closed case the chapter remembers, as enemy id to the boolean tag it sets. A Spawn gated on `!tag` then stays empty on every later visit, so a refused salesman never comes back (design doc 7.4).

climax.description: The choice an event card offers before the boss (design doc 7.4): a boolean tag it sets, and what that costs. With the flag on, the boss summons `summonFactor` times as many enemies at once and may keep that many times as many alive, and going to bed files only `archiveFactor` of the desk.

summonFactor.description: Multiplier on the boss's summon count and cap while the flag is on.

archiveFactor.description: Multiplier on what sleep files while the flag is on.

ChapterLink.description: Two doors that open onto each other. Each end is room#door, where door is the Door object's name in Tiled. The sockets must face each other (N with S, E with W).
